listing.name: Super Mario Odyssey (MacNativeGames)
listing.summary: An early community Super Mario Odyssey port running title-specific rewritten ARM64 code on Apple Silicon. The project reports only Cap Kingdom/Bonneton at 60 FPS on an M3, rather than a full game. Follow games/odyssey/README.md for the source build and exact prerequisites; generated app/game content stays private. Use your own version 1.3.0. Exact region, executable hashes, extraction, key and font requirements still need that title-specific guide; other platforms are unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
